cases.prompt: Grant a supported role to an existing user while preserving every other grant. Run the starter as `python cli.py access grant USER ROLE`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. Unknown users or roles fail without mutation. Store access state in `access.json`. Do not integrate an external identity provider.

Change only the due label of one appointment. Run the starter as `python cli.py appointment reschedule ID DUE`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. Unknown IDs or an empty due label fail without mutation. Store appointments in `appointments.json`. Do not send notifications.

Add bookmark tags without changing existing URLs or titles. Run the starter as `python cli.py bookmark tag ID TAG`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. The command adds one tag; unknown IDs fail without mutation. Store tags with bookmarks in `bookmarks.json`. Do not add network synchronization.

Merge a named config overlay while preserving unrelated keys. Run the starter as `python cli.py config merge NAME`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. The command applies a named overlay; missing overlays fail without writing. Store merged configuration in `config.json`. Do not infer environment defaults.

Import contacts from CSV and reject malformed rows without partial persistence. Run the starter as `python cli.py contacts import FILE`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. The command imports valid CSV contacts; malformed rows reject the import. Store contacts in `contacts.json`. Do not deduplicate by guessed identity.

Record an expense amount and reject negative amounts without changing the ledger. Run the starter as `python cli.py expense add AMOUNT NOTE`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. The command records one expense; negative amounts fail without mutation. Store entries in `expenses.json`. Do not calculate tax.

Set one boolean feature flag in a named environment while preserving all other flags and metadata. Run the starter as `python cli.py flag set ENV NAME VALUE`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. Unknown environments or non-boolean values fail without mutation. Store flags in `flags.json`. Do not perform deployment or rollout actions.

Atomically move an item quantity between two locations while preserving all other inventory metadata. Run the starter as `python cli.py inventory transfer ITEM FROM TO QUANTITY`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. Unknown items or locations, insufficient stock, and invalid quantities fail without mutation. Store inventory in `inventory.json`. Do not replenish stock automatically.

Cancel an eligible order and store its cancellation reason. Run the starter as `python cli.py order cancel ID REASON`; every invocation emits one `StarterObservation.v1` JSON object to stdout. A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. Unknown or already completed orders fail without mutation. Store orders in `orders.json`. Do not process refunds.

Store the playlist in `playlist.json`. Do not deduplicate tracks.

A completed operation emits `status="completed"`, `exit_code=0`, `changed=true`, and its resulting state digest. The command marks one todo complete; unknown IDs fail without mutation.
